title: Resolve the privacy-clean wording base conflict with main
public_pr_body:
Resolve the shared plain-English base's chase settings label conflict with main. Start from the five-file privacy cleanup (#206), merge current main, and retain the reviewed Days before or after due date label. No behavior or assertions are changed to settle the conflict.

Base: codex/plain-english-privacy. This follows #206 and provides a clean shared base for the older wording/costing descendants (#139/#140/#145/#166/#169 and their mixed predecessors). Descendants must incorporate the base update; their old heads are not changed by this PR. No docs diff and no SQL applied.

Validation: focused plain-English and costing UI tests, targeted ESLint, whitespace checks and merge-tree comparison with main 787ba18. Live browser/database tests and production build were not run.
